reason: Conversation 1 is thin and wastes a turn re-asking what the opener already said, but it stays honest, refuses to guess at a part, gives a correct safety boundary and sends her to an engineer, which matches the genuinely uncertain hidden truth. Conversation 2 engages more and suggests some reasonable listening checks, but it anchors on the drain pump from the first line, ignores the frozen-display symptom that points equally at pressure switch or control board, and makes unsupported claims ('points strongly to a small object', 'a failing pump would happen every time rather than randomly'), with only a weak, conditional engineer referral at the end. Neither asked for the flash pattern or full model number, so the margin is slight, but correct uncertainty and escalation beat confident misdirection.
